comment: Every one of the 32 modules carries the same context menu and nothing else: a Panel Theme label, the items Light and Dark, and Dark as default. It is cosmetic and identical throughout, so it gets no line on any module. Dark as default toggles a plugin-wide setting written to dBiz.json in the user folder; it is read in each module's constructor, so it sets the panel of dBiz modules added to the rack afterwards and leaves modules already in the rack alone. No dBiz module is blank or decorative, so none of them is the case where the theme would be the point.
